scope: Padang Arunika ground grass and existing protruding grass tufts only

ground.derivation: Opaque wrapped tile composited from 2600 rotated source-atlas tufts. Matching alpha, normal rotation, roughness and deterministic seed 73581. Not the complete source atlas pasted on terrain.

tufts.placement: Existing instanced matrices and count retained. Three source-atlas cutout cards per tuft.

normalRoughnessPacking: RGB = OpenGL tangent-space normal, A = roughness (NOT transparency). Linear data, no alpha premultiplication.
orientation: Top-down image rows, Texture.flipY=true. EXR rows corrected before conversion; filtered normals renormalized.
colorSpace: Color textures sRGB. Packed normal/roughness linear.
preserved: Rocky Terrain textures, rocky mask, roads, terrain geometry, collision, gameplay, all other maps.
